english_policy.notes.3: For MCDS, current SCS instructions do not permit the five-year U.S.-degree exception: scores before 2024-09-01 are excluded. The older MCDS apply URL returned HTTP 404 after redirection during this review; search-cached thresholds were not imported.

source_excerpt: If you are applying to MCDS and MHCI
fact_summary: Current SCS instructions explicitly restrict the extended English-score exception for MCDS. Failed legacy pages and cached threshold snippets do not establish current minima.
